sources.title: Generative Language API v1beta - Package cloud.google.com/go/ai ...
sources.snippet: The Gemini API allows developers to build generative AI applications using Gemini models. Gemini is our most capable model, built from the ground up to be multimodal. It can generalize and seamlessly understand, operate across, and combine different types of information including language, images, audio, video, and code.
